BC001: Every residential building must comply with National Building Code (NBC) India structural safety guidelines.
BC002: Minimum habitable room height should be 2.7 meters as per Indian building standards.
BC003: Every habitable room must have proper natural light and ventilation through windows or openings.
BC004: Fire exits must always remain accessible and unobstructed in all multi-storey buildings.
BC005: Staircase minimum width in residential buildings should be at least 0.9 meters.
C001: Basic residential construction cost in India ranges from 1200 to 1800 rupees per square foot.
C002: Standard construction cost in India ranges from 1800 to 2500 rupees per square foot including basic finishing.
C003: Premium construction cost ranges from 2500 to 4000 rupees per square foot depending on materials and design quality.
E001: Load-bearing walls transfer structural loads from slabs and beams to the foundation safely.
E002: Columns must be vertically aligned across floors to ensure proper load transfer.
E003: Beams resist bending moments and shear forces in RCC structures.
S001: Slabs distribute loads to beams and columns in reinforced concrete structures.
S002: Columns carry axial loads from upper floors down to foundations.
S003: Footings spread structural loads into soil to prevent settlement failure.
R001: A standard bedroom should be 120 to 150 square feet for comfortable living.
R002: Living room should be placed near the main entrance for easy access and social use.
R003: Kitchen should ideally be placed in the southeast direction for fire element balance.
P001: Public spaces like living rooms should be placed near the entrance of the house.
P002: Private spaces like bedrooms should be placed deeper inside the house for privacy.
P003: Kitchen and bathroom should be grouped as wet areas to reduce plumbing cost.
V001: Main entrance in north or east direction is considered most auspicious in vastu.
V002: Kitchen should ideally be placed in the southeast direction according to vastu principles.
V003: Master bedroom is best located in the southwest direction for stability.
V004: Pooja room should be placed in the northeast direction for spiritual balance.
